correctness.rationale: For n>=5, adjacency Fourier eigenvalues of fixed unit-weight C_n^2 are a_k=4*cos(2pi*k/n)^2+2*cos(2pi*k/n)-2. Different cosine values collide only when their sum is -1/2. Averaging zeta^k+zeta^-k+zeta^l+zeta^-l=-1 over cyclotomic Galois automorphisms gives mu(r)/phi(r)+mu(s)/phi(s)=-1/2; elementary order classification restricts actual extra collisions to (2,6), (3,4), and distinct cosine values from order5. They yield eigenspaces of dimensions 3 for 6|n, 4 for 12|n, and 4 for 5|n respectively; other nonconstant conjugate pairs have dimension at most two. PBH requires at least maximum multiplicity control channels, and the first d consecutive vertices give nonzero Fourier Vandermonde determinant on each d-dimensional eigenspace, so exactly q(n)=4 if 5|n or12|n; else 3 if 6|n; else 2. Independent direct numerical eigenspectrum tests over all 5<=n<=180 agreed. The finite test is diagnostic; analytic cyclotomic and Vandermonde arguments prove all n. No claim concerns arbitrary edge weights, input effort, or structural controllability.
